words.sentence: She always associates the smell of rain with her childhood.
words.sentence_zh: 她总是把雨的味道和童年联系在一起。

words.sentence: I assumed you would be late, so I started without you.
words.sentence_zh: 我以为你会迟到，所以先开始了。

words.sentence: Despite the rain, we went hiking and had a great time.
words.sentence_zh: 尽管下着雨，我们还是去爬山了，玩得很开心。

words.sentence: The judge will determine the result after hearing both sides.
words.sentence_zh: 法官听完双方陈述后会确定结果。

words.sentence: This new app makes our work more efficient.
words.sentence_zh: 这个新应用让我们的工作更高效。

words.sentence: Watching that movie was emotional, and I cried at the end.
words.sentence_zh: 看那部电影很感人，结尾我哭了。

words.sentence: The company was established in 2010 by two engineers.
words.sentence_zh: 这家公司是2010年由两位工程师创立的。

words.sentence: The executive team will meet next week to discuss the budget.
words.sentence_zh: 高管团队下周开会讨论预算。

words.sentence: I can't figure out why the printer stopped working.
words.sentence_zh: 我想不通打印机为什么不工作了。

words.sentence: Many families need better financial advice before buying a house.
words.sentence_zh: 很多家庭在买房前需要更好的财务建议。

words.sentence: Doctors can identify the problem by checking your blood.
words.sentence_zh: 医生可以通过检查血液找出问题所在。

words.sentence: Social media can have a big impact on teenagers.
words.sentence_zh: 社交媒体会对青少年产生很大影响。

words.sentence: Each individual student has a different learning style.
words.sentence_zh: 每个学生的学习风格都不同。

words.sentence: The team came up with an innovative idea to save water.
words.sentence_zh: 团队想出了一个创新的节水办法。

words.sentence: Many people invest their savings in stocks and funds.
words.sentence_zh: 很多人把积蓄投资到股票和基金中。

words.sentence: The factory needs more labor to finish the order on time.
words.sentence_zh: 工厂需要更多劳动力才能按时完成订单。

words.sentence: The landscape near the lake looks beautiful in autumn.
words.sentence_zh: 秋天湖边的景观非常美。

words.sentence: I only go to the gym on occasional weekends.
words.sentence_zh: 我只是偶尔在周末去健身房。

words.sentence: Overall, the trip was fun, although the weather was cold.
words.sentence_zh: 总的来说这次旅行很有趣，虽然天气有点冷。

words.sentence: She has a particular interest in ancient history.
words.sentence_zh: 她对古代历史有一种特别的兴趣。

words.sentence: The school changed its policy on late homework.
words.sentence_zh: 学校改变了迟交作业的政策。

words.sentence: Many students feel pressure before final exams.
words.sentence_zh: 很多学生在期末考试前感到压力。

words.sentence: My previous job was in a bank, but now I work online.
words.sentence_zh: 我以前在银行工作，现在改做网络工作了。

words.sentence: Learning a new language is a slow process.
words.sentence_zh: 学习一门新语言是个慢慢来的过程。

words.sentence: Please give me a specific example of your idea.
words.sentence_zh: 请给我一个你这个想法的具体例子。

words.sentence: Our strategy is to focus on quality rather than price.
words.sentence_zh: 我们的策略是注重质量，而不是价格。

words.sentence: The contract has several terms that you should read carefully.
words.sentence_zh: 这份合同有几条条款，你应该仔细读。

words.sentence: Heavy rain threatened to ruin our picnic plans.
words.sentence_zh: 大雨差点毁了我们的野餐计划。

words.sentence: Short videos are a growing trend among young people.
words.sentence_zh: 短视频是年轻人中越来越流行的趋势。
